faqs.q: What services does Grupo Castro Fallas offer?
faqs.a: We offer comprehensive logistics solutions, including ocean, air and land transportation, customs management, bonded and general warehousing, international transportation and specialized services to support import and export operations.

faqs.q: How can I request a quote?
faqs.a: You can request a quote from the Quotes section of our website. Share your cargo details, including origin, destination and shipment characteristics, so our team can assess your needs and offer a suitable solution.

faqs.q: How can I track my shipment?
faqs.a: You can check your shipment status in the Tracking section of our website using the tracking information for your operation. If you need further assistance, our team is available to help.

faqs.q: Do you handle FCL and LCL?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer ocean freight FCL (full container load) and LCL (less than container load), with flexible options based on your cargo volume, logistics needs and operational requirements.

about.title: About Us
about.introduction: Castro Fallas Logística Internacional is a company founded 48 years ago to meet the needs of the different links in the logistics chain and the many stakeholders involved. We manage, coordinate and supervise freight transportation by different means, nationally and internationally, for import and export cargo.
